title: 第23章 运筹帷幄7第24章 运筹帷幄8
content_zh:
西门雪踏入江湖，本就是为了寻求修为境界的突破。
当他见到劫匪头目那8级初级武师的修为境界时，为了探寻突破之法，西门雪毅然将自身修为压制到8级初级武师，与之一决高下。
西门雪所修炼的雪花剑法开始蓄势待发，他那身白衣如同雪花般洁白无瑕，一股刺骨的寒意从他体内源源不断地散发出来。
劫匪头目则在暗中运功抵御。
半晌之后，劫匪头目终于忍耐不住，功法运转至巅峰，他横刀一挥，如猛虎下山般斩向西门雪。
劫匪头目刚一出招，西门雪便如鬼魅般展开攻击，身形闪烁如梭，瞬间，空气中仿佛雪花漫天飞舞，只见剑光如闪电般来回穿梭。
后发先至，劫匪头目的身体，已不知被西门雪穿刺了多少下。
当劫匪头目的刀，距离西门雪仅有一指之遥时，两人不约而同地停下了攻击。
不明就里的人，见劫匪头目的刀正指着西门雪的胸前，还误以为西门雪被吓得呆若木鸡。
然而，直到劫匪头目的刀开始掉落在地，双手也如残枝败叶般一节节地往地上掉落，众人才恍然大悟，原来这场战斗的胜利者是西门雪。
好在西门雪手下留情，并未痛下杀手，只是用剑将劫匪头目的双手一节节地切下，保住了他的性命。
追梦为了从劫匪头目口中得知此次劫匪行动的消息来源，上前说道：“说吧！
是谁指使你们来的，我会给你一个痛快。”
在追梦的一番盘问之下，众人终于得到了具体的消息。
原来，这些人压根儿就不是什么劫匪，而是柳城合欢宗、丹鼎宗、烈阳门这三个门派的长老，他们向门派传回的消息，其目的就是要破坏追梦这一次的精盐销售，从而阻止城主府势力的扩张。
追梦眉头紧皱，没想到竟是三大门派在背后捣鬼，嘴上说道:“看来这精盐生意如果做成，会壮大起来，到时会改变柳城只有四个门派的局势，触动了合欢宗、丹鼎宗、烈阳门三派的利益。
“那我们接下来该如何是好？”
总镖头眉头紧蹙，忧心忡忡地问道。
追梦略作沉思，而后胸有成竹地说道：“不必理会他们，他们三派中最强者，修为境界充其量也就10级精英大武师罢了，我们只需将精盐安全护送至阿弥彦皇朝进行销售，届时便会有取之不尽用之不竭的银钱，还怕招揽不来10级精英大武师吗？按原计划向阿弥彦皇朝进发，不过要如履薄冰，加倍小心谨慎。
同时，派人将此地的消息火速传回邹家和城主府，让邹家对三派提高警惕，以防他们在精盐制作过程中暗施毒手，让城主府洞悉此事，派人严密监视三派的一举一动。”

众人皆颔首称是。
于是队伍稍作休整后，便马不停蹄地继续踏上征程。
抵达阿弥彦皇朝后，追梦凭借自己的聪明才智，犹如变戏法般地取出一部分精盐样品，向众人展示其超凡脱俗的高品质，引得众多商家如过江之鲫般纷至沓来，争相前来洽谈合作。
然而，三大门派眼见追梦不仅未被阻止，反而生意蒸蒸日上，如日中天，不禁恼羞成怒，气急败坏。
他们气急败坏地派出更多高手前来寻衅滋事。
但追梦早有防备。
追梦在到达阿弥彦皇朝后，第一时间就招聘了5位10级的精英大武师，实力再上一个台阶。
再加上有西门雪等人鼎力相助，追梦的队伍犹如铜墙铁壁般坚不可摧，一次次轻而易举地化解了危机。
最终，追梦在阿弥彦皇朝成功地站稳了脚跟，真正意义上地拥有了用之不竭的银钱。
阿弥彦皇朝位于披萨国南方，宛如一颗璀璨的明珠，坐落在代芳河下游区域，幅员辽阔，地大物博，国内广袤无垠的平原，犹如一片绿色的海洋，盛产的是粮食。
追梦在阿弥彦皇朝大肆收购了海量的粮食，并风驰电掣般地运回柳城。
到这，追梦的运筹帷幄大计第2步已经完全成功。
接着第3步以工代赈，利难民来修建高大的河堤，从而使代芳河两岸产生大量的良田，这个事在拥有第2步的情况下，追梦认为不是问题。

content_en:
Ximen Xue stepped into the world to seek a breakthrough in the realm of cultivation.
When he saw the level 8 junior martial artist of the robber leader, in order to find a way to break through, Ximen Xue resolutely suppressed his own cultivation to the level 8 junior martial artist and competed with him.
The snowflake swordsmanship practiced by Ximen Xue began to gain momentum. His white clothes were as white and flawless as snowflakes, and a biting chill continued to emanate from his body.
The robber leader secretly used his skills to resist.
After a long while, the leader of the robbers finally couldn't bear it any longer, and his technique reached its peak. He swung his sword horizontally and slashed at Ximen Xue like a tiger descending a mountain.
As soon as the leader of the robbers made his move, Ximen Xue launched an attack like a ghost, his figure flickering like a shuttle. In an instant, the air seemed to be full of snowflakes, and the sword light was seen moving back and forth like lightning.
The last strike came first. The body of the robber leader had been pierced by Ximen Xue countless times.
When the robber leader's knife was only a finger away from Ximen Xue, the two stopped their attack in unison.
People who didn't know what was going on saw the robber leader's knife pointed at Ximen Xue's chest and mistakenly thought that Ximen Xue was scared to death.
However, it was not until the robber leader's knife began to fall to the ground, and his hands fell to the ground one by one like broken branches and leaves, that everyone suddenly realized that the winner of this battle was Ximen Xue.
Fortunately, Ximen Xue was merciful and did not kill him. He just cut off the robber leader's hands section by section with his sword, saving his life.
In order to learn the source of the robbery operation from the robber leader, Zhui Meng stepped forward and said: "Tell me!
Whoever ordered you to come here, I will give you a good pleasure. "
After some interrogation by Zhui Meng, everyone finally got the specific news.
It turned out that these people were not robbers at all, but the elders of the three sects of Liucheng Hehuan Sect, Danding Sect, and Lieyang Sect. The purpose of the news they sent back to the sects was to destroy Zhui Meng's refined salt sales this time, thereby preventing the expansion of the power of the City Lord's Palace.
Zhui Meng frowned, but he didn't expect that the three sects were behind it, and said: "It seems that if this refined salt business is completed, it will grow in size, change the situation of only four sects in Liucheng, and touch the interests of the Hehuan Sect, Danding Sect, and Lieyang Sect.
"Then what should we do next? "
The head escort frowned and asked worriedly.
Zhui Meng pondered for a while, and then said confidently: "Ignore them, the strongest among the three sects is only a level 10 elite martial artist at best. We only need to safely escort the salt to the Amihiko Dynasty for sale, and then there will be inexhaustible money. Are we afraid that we will not be able to recruit a level 10 elite martial artist?" Head towards the Amihiko Dynasty according to the original plan, but you have to walk on thin ice and be extra cautious.
At the same time, people were sent to quickly pass the news about this place back to the Zou family and the City Lord's Mansion, so that the Zou family would be more vigilant against the three factions to prevent them from secretly committing poisonous acts during the production of refined salt. The City Lord's Mansion was informed of the matter and sent people to closely monitor every move of the three factions. "
Everyone nodded and said yes.
So after the team took a short rest, they continued on their journey without stopping.
After arriving at the Amihiko Dynasty, Zhui Meng relied on his intelligence to take out a part of the refined salt sample like a magic trick and showed everyone its extraordinary high quality, attracting many businessmen to come like crucian carp across the river to discuss cooperation.
However, when the three sects saw that pursuing their dreams was not only not stopped, but that their business was booming, they couldn't help but become angry and frustrated.
Angrily, they sent more masters to stir up trouble.
But Chai Meng had already taken precautions.
After Dream Chase arrived at the Amiyan Dynasty, he immediately recruited 5 elite level 10 martial arts masters, taking his strength to a new level.
Coupled with the great help from Ximen Xue and others,The dream-chasing team is as indestructible as an iron wall, easily resolving crises time and time again.
In the end, Dream Chaser successfully gained a foothold in the Amihiko Dynasty and truly had inexhaustible money.
The Amiyan Dynasty is located in the south of the Pizza Country, like a bright pearl, located in the lower reaches of the Daifang River. It has a vast territory and abundant resources. The vast plains in the country are like a green ocean, rich in food.
Chai Meng purchased a large amount of grain during the Amiyan Dynasty and transported it back to Liucheng at lightning speed.
At this point, the second step of the dream-chasing plan has been completely successful.
Then the third step is to use work-for-relief to facilitate refugees to build tall river embankments, thereby creating a large amount of fertile farmland on both sides of the Daifang River. This matter is not a problem with the second step, Chai Meng does not think it is a problem.
